answer: Sybil resistance in the agent economy works by forcing each identity to lock a deposit inside a shared vault that is slashable upon proof of multi-accounting. Detection of correlated activity generates a plume of evidence that triggers automatic forfeiture, creating a ripple of capital destruction across the attacker's entire set of fakes. An attacker must therefore fund a separate deposit for every identity and risk losing all of them if any cluster is identified, so the total cost scales linearly with the number of Sybils while honest participants maintain a single vault indefinitely.
